claim_tested: GOST seven-TM bundles form a large cavity open to the membrane outer leaflet, and are neither channels nor GPCRs
key_finding: TMEM87A in lipid nanodiscs has a GOLD domain atop a seven-TM domain with a large cavity open to solution and the membrane outer leaflet; the authors state TMEM87A may not function as an ion channel or GPCR, and place WLS in the same GOST family
confidence_and_limitations: high for TMEM87A itself; transfer to yeast PTM1 is inference from fold similarity, not a measurement on PTM1

claim_tested: a lipid can occupy the GOST transmembrane cavity and modulate cargo binding
key_finding: a phospholipid in the core of Wnt-bound WLS regulates the association and dissociation between Wnt and WLS, indicating a lipid-mediated Wnt secretion mechanism
confidence_and_limitations: high for WLS; PTM1 has no Wnt-like cargo in yeast, so only the lipid-in-cavity principle transfers

claim_tested: whether GOST TM bundles move like GPCRs
key_finding: Wnt release is driven by conformational changes in the WLS transmembrane domain described as reminiscent of GPCR activation, with WLS called a GPCR-like transporter
confidence_and_limitations: supports a dynamic transporter rather than a static pocket; the GPCR comparison is about helix motion, not about G protein coupling, and should not be read as support for GPCR activity

claim_tested: what cellular process the family serves
key_finding: GPR107 localizes to the trans-Golgi network, is essential for retrograde transport and for intoxication by Pseudomonas exotoxin A, and is cleaved by furin; the N-terminal region is critical
confidence_and_limitations: the paper still calls GPR107 an orphan GPCR and speculates about G protein association, which is the kind of database carry-over a curator must not propagate; the retrograde transport phenotype matches the existing yeast BP term

key_finding: GPR107 and GPR108 define a family with an N-terminal signal peptide, a long extracellular domain and a C-terminal seven-TM LUSTR domain similar to GPCRs
confidence_and_limitations: the phrase similar to GPCRs is a sequence-level impression from 2007 and predates the GOST structures; it is the origin of the LU7TM and LUSTR naming on UniProt P32857

claim_tested: what is already annotated on PTM1
key_finding: signal 1-26, lumenal 27-197, seven TM helices 198-438, cytoplasmic 439-523, N-glycosylation at N132, Pfam PF06814 GOST_TM and PF21902 PTM1-like_N; GO terms cover CC and one BP (GO:0042147) with no MF
confidence_and_limitations: database-level; the cytosol term GO:0005829 is inconsistent with the topology and should be reviewed

claim_tested: PTM1 adopts the GOST fold rather than a GPCR fold
key_finding: PTM1 to TMEM87A (8CTJ) TM-score 0.657 with 243 aligned residues; PTM1 to WLS 0.409 with 111 aligned after transitive seeding; PTM1 to rhodopsin 0.530 with only 146 aligned over a 348-residue target; TMEM87A to WLS control 0.411-0.515
context: AlphaFold model of P32857 against experimental structures
confidence_and_limitations: the rhodopsin score is high because any 7TM bundle scores well against a short target; the discriminator is the aligned length over the longer GOST target, not the score alone

claim_tested: PTM1 has a large hydrophobic internal cavity like TMEM87A and WLS, unlike GPCRs
key_finding: PTM1 1884 A^3 (lining 60.8 percent hydrophobic, mean KD +0.69), YHL017W 1194 A^3 (+0.94), TMEM87A 2224 A^3 (+0.44), WLS 1168 A^3 (+0.54) against rhodopsin 514 A^3 (-0.66) and M1 muscarinic 409 A^3 (-0.43)
context: one consistent protocol across six structures
confidence_and_limitations: all four GOST cavities have positive mean lining hydropathy and both GPCR pockets negative; PTM1 is an AlphaFold model, where looser side chain packing can inflate the measured volume

claim_tested: the PTM1 cavity is accessible from the bilayer rather than sealed
key_finding: PTM1 portal radius 3.39 A with 21 of 180 rays admitting a 1.8 A probe, lined by F280, I347, Y350 and F387; TMEM87A 2.13 A; rhodopsin 0.67 A; KcsA 0.21 A
context: AlphaFold model and three experimental structures
confidence_and_limitations: the clearest single discriminator against both a sealed GPCR pocket and an ion pore; a static model cannot show that the portal is used, and model packing may widen it

citation: this work, class A motif regex
claim_tested: PTM1 is not a class A GPCR
key_finding: DRY/ERY, NPxxY and CWxP are all absent from PTM1, YHL017W, TMEM87A and WLS, and all present in rhodopsin (ERY@134, NPVIY@302, CWLP@264) and partly in M1R (DRY@122, NPMCY@414)
confidence_and_limitations: a clean negative; absence of motifs cannot by itself exclude an unrelated receptor mechanism, only the class A one

claim_tested: the transmembrane cavity is under elevated purifying selection in fungi
key_finding: cavity-lining TM residues (n=60, median identity 0.273) are not more conserved than other TM residues (n=181, median 0.159): one-sided Mann-Whitney U=5658, p=0.314, rank-biserial r=0.042; Fisher on identity>=0.80 counts p=0.355, OR=1.42
context: 45 fungal GOST orthologs, one per fungal order
confidence_and_limitations: refutes the conservation limb of the seed hypothesis as stated; conservation was measured as exact identity, so a test on physicochemical class could give a different answer

claim_tested: whether the conserved cavity chemistry is shared across the GOST family
key_finding: nine near-invariant fungal cavity residues (Y199, E241, Y249, S279, L283, W414, R417, D422, Y429), eight of them polar or aromatic, cluster at the lumenal end; mapped onto TMEM87A through the 0.657 superposition only E241 to E272 keeps its identity (Y199 to F230, Y249 to F280, S279 to A308, R417 to L438, D422 to A443, Y429 to F449)
confidence_and_limitations: blocks transfer of a TMEM87A or WLS ligand assignment to PTM1; at about 17 percent identity and CA deviations of 1.0-3.6 A single-residue equivalences can be off by one position

key_finding: PF06814 matches exactly two S. cerevisiae S288C proteins, P32857 (PTM1/YKL039W) and P38745 (YHL017W); across Fungi the family spans 492 species and 289 genera, with 473 of 500 entries also carrying PF21902
confidence_and_limitations: YHL017W has an equivalent cavity (1194 A^3, lining hydropathy +0.94), so no cavity-based measurement distinguishes the two paralogs

claim_tested: is there any primary literature on yeast PTM1
key_finding: searches for PTM1 with Saccharomyces cerevisiae, for YKL039W, and for PTM1 yeast vacuolar membrane protein returned no papers
confidence_and_limitations: the absence of retrieved papers reflects both a genuinely under-studied gene and a strict conjunctive search tool; a curator should check SGD directly before concluding that nothing exists
